nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build for the FastAPI + LangGraph backend, pinned to Python 3.10-slim for numpy/numba wheel compatibility, installing CPU-only PyTorch from a dedicated index before the rest of requirements.txt, then copying in the app and scripts directories and launching via scripts/start.sh on port 8000.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately avoids Docker multi-stage builds; instead orders RUN layers (setuptools/wheel, then CPU-only torch via --extra-index-url, then --no-build-isolation pip install -r requirements.txt) to dodge CUDA wheel bloat and an openai-whisper sdist build failure against modern setuptools.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes caches, virtualenvs, git metadata, and generated artifacts (frames/, transcripts/, logs) from the backend Docker build context to keep image builds small and deterministic.
